description: Add a history of a clump value. A history is a table of floating point values assigned by sampling a model attribute periodically during a simulation. The clump must be specified by either 'id' or 'position' keyword following the quantity keyword. The history can be assigned a name for later reference with the optional name keyword; if not, the history will be given a default name based on its internally assigned id number. Quantities that can be recorded include position, velocity, displacement, spin, euler, force-contact, force-unbalanced, moment-contact, moment-unbalanced, stress, ratio-local, and convergence. Live 9.7: the quantity slot was fully enumerated (Batch P1); an object selector (id <i> or position <v>) is REQUIRED after the quantity - omitting it fails with 'No object for history specified'.

6.0: Live 6.00 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity.
7.0: Live 7.0 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity (same grammar as 9.x).

The selector is 'id <i>' or 'position <v>'; 'index <i>' (one component of a vector quantity) and 'log' parse after the quantity on live 7.00 and 9.8; 'magnitude', 'vector' and a separate component token (e.g. 'stress zz') are rejected - use the per-component keywords.
9.0: Live 9.7 first-slot enumeration; an object selector is required after the quantity. The selector is 'id <i>' or 'position <v>'.

'[clumphistoryblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where a modifier may follow the quantity. 'index <i>' (one component of a vector quantity) and 'log' parse after the quantity on live 7.00 and 9.8; 'magnitude', 'vector' and a separate component token (e.g. 'stress zz') are rejected - use the per-component keywords.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: itasca.command('clump history ...') or manually record values using itasca.set_callback() with Clump getter methods
